SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Check when the app opens
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Starts a check straight away, so you only need to open the app and put the phone down.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: No monitor beeps at night
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Switches are still logged and shown, just without sound. Quick checks always beep.

Preference.app:summary: Beeps play on the alarm channel, so they sound even when the phone is on silent.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Flicker limit (%)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Light wobble above this counts as moteur. Set automatically by the 'It's kahraba / It's moteur' buttons.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Minutes of steady light before calling kahraba

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Careful kahraba detection
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: After a cut, wait until the moteur has flickered at least once (or 3x the steady time) before calling kahraba.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Moteur from flicker alone
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Switch to moteur when the light flickers even without a power cut. Off by default because kahraba can wobble too.

Preference.app:title: How to use Ijit
Preference.app:summary: Full guide: which lights work, distance, solar and UPS, and the disclaimer.

Preference.app:title: How it works
Preference.app:summary: Halogen bulbs flicker on the moteur and stay steady on kahraba. The phone's light sensor watches for that flicker. Use a halogen or old-style filament bulb; most LED and energy-saving bulbs hide it.

Preference.app:title: Solar inverters and UPS
Preference.app:summary: Doesn't work if your lights run through a solar inverter or UPS. They produce smooth power whatever feeds them, so every check would say kahraba. An inverter's own screen or app (input voltage and frequency) is the better guide there.
